<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/admin/backups/encryption/key"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Signed-in admin only. Generates an age X25519 key as the **pending**
key: backups keep using the current key until the admin downloads the
new key's kit and confirms it with `PUT /api/admin/backups/encryption`
(`enabled: true, kitSaved: true`), which makes it current. Older keys
are kept, so this server can still restore the backups made with
them. The secret only leaves the server through
`GET /api/admin/backups/encryption/kit`.
